contract.application_relevance: Workers route collection and item URLs through one pattern and inspect optional named fields.
contract.candidate_classification: assertion-bearing ordinary API correctness candidate; no reviewed census credit yet
contract.cleanup: All URL, params, iterator, pattern, array, and result values are request-local. Return from synchronous fetch releases references. No timer, outgoing fetch, binding, durable write, object URL allocation, or retained cross-request capability. External supervisor stops only owned processes and deletes only its fresh deployment/store directory after receipt capture.
contract.desired_behavior: Absent optional id is an own property with undefined value; result edits do not affect a later exec.
contract.distinctness: Optional capture shape and per-call result ownership, rather than base resolution or regexp restriction.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(missing !== null && present !== null, true, 'optional segment matches with and without capture');
t.equal(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(missing.pathname.groups, 'id'), true, 'unmatched optional group is present as a property');
t.equal(missing.pathname.groups.id, undefined, 'unmatched optional group value is undefined');
t.equal(again.pathname.groups.id, '42', 'exec result groups are fresh on each call');
t.equal(pattern.test('https://library.example.test/books/42/extra'), false, 'optional segment does not consume extra path components');
t.equal(pattern.hasRegExpGroups, false, 'ordinary named optional group is not custom regexp');
contract.hypothesis: An unmatched group may be omitted or represented as empty string, or mutation of one result may affect later matches.
contract.mechanism: Optional pathname group materialization and result freshness
contract.ordinary_input_scope: Successful public API calls on complete ordinary URL strings or valid property, pair, and pattern inputs. Valid URL nonmatches are intentional boolean/null outcomes, never malformed-input probes. Example domains and documentation IPv6 addresses are data only.
preconditions: Fresh isolated fixture deployment on the exact reviewed direct-celld build; external source/build/process witness required.
Global URL, URLSearchParams, and for U217-U220 URLPattern are supplied by celld, not by Node, a shim, or a mock.
External finite-deadline supervisor and owned-process cleanup are available; missing runtime prerequisites are BLOCKED.

runtime_operations: Construct /books/:id? and exec both collection and item URLs.
Assert both match; optional group exists with undefined value when absent and 42 when present.
Edit the present result and exec again to assert fresh groups.
Reject a valid URL with an extra segment and assert no custom regexp groups.

contract.source_observation: JS maps regex captures into a freshly allocated groups object. Optional-group undefined is explicitly asserted before JSON serialization.
